title: Variance-friendly scoring model
description: Pure C# ScoreModel in Barcade.Core that accumulates per-player wins/losses across many microgames, embodying the GDD law-of-large-numbers design (raw accumulation, no nested randomness or hidden multipliers).
acceptance_criteria: ScoreModel records a per-player win or loss for each microgame round.
Exposes per-player totals, WinRate, and LeadingPlayer (deterministic tie handling that can report multiple leaders).
No layered randomness or hidden score multipliers are applied — accumulation is transparent.
EditMode tests cover accumulation, leader selection, tie handling, and empty/initial state.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Done. ScoreModel (Barcade.Core) with per-player wins/losses/games, WinRate (zero-games guarded), GetLeaders (all tied) + GetSingleLeader (deterministic lowest-index). Raw accumulation, no RNG/multipliers. 71/71 fast tests green (~93ms). Test commit 564dbdc, impl a71ed8b. Reviewer APPROVED, no HIGH. Carry-forward (non-blocking): [MEDIUM] add null/length-4 guard to RecordRound — fold into TASK-005 (first real caller); [LOW] pin the lowest-index tie-break rule explicitly in a test; [LOW] avoid List alloc in GetSingleLeader if called per-frame.
